root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `sizeof(*map->osd_weight)` to `map->max_osd * sizeof(*map->osd_weight)` in the `ceph_decode_need()` call (net/ceph/osdmap.c:1705-1708). The CVE description confirms that the check only accounts for one weight entry, leading to potential out-of-bounds access.
